_doc: Local-kind A/B for cardinality-cliff #1: checkpoint durability via one syncfs() barrier (--wal-checkpoint-syncfs on) vs the per-stream fdatasync loop (baseline). Same cluster, two labeled wal configs, high-enough cardinality (20k/50k) that the checkpoint's O(N_touched) fdatasync phase is a real cost. Compare throughput + WAL_CKPT fsync_us (--wal-stats 2) between labels. This is the local gate: if syncfs is faster (or clearly lower checkpoint fsync cost) here, promote to a remote NVMe run.
